articles.title: Saudi Airport Attacks Pressure Trump to Boost US Role in Yemen - Bloomberg.com
articles.description: A barrage of drone and missile attacks on Saudi Arabia has intensified pressure on Washington to step up efforts to help its close ally battle Iran-backed Houthi militants in neighboring Yemen.
